mapper.sql: cast(r.id as char) id, r.requisition_no requisitionNo, cast(r.applicant_id as char) applicantId, d.name department, u.display_name applicant, r.required_date requiredDate, r.purpose, r.budget_amount budgetAmount, r.status, r.created_at createdAt
mapper.select: select , (select count(*) from fs_business_attachment a where a.business_type='REQUISITION' and a.business_id=r.id and a.deleted=0) attachmentCount from pr_requisition r join sys_department d on d.id=r.department_id join sys_user u on u.id=r.applicant_id where r.deleted=0 and ${scope} order by r.id desc
select count(*) from pr_requisition r where

select , (select count(*) from pr_requisition_item i where i.requisition_id=r.id and i.deleted=0) itemCount from pr_requisition r join sys_department d on d.id=r.department_id join sys_user u on u.id=r.applicant_id where
order by r.id desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}

select cast(r.id as char) id, r.requisition_no requisitionNo, cast(r.department_id as char) departmentId, cast(r.applicant_id as char) applicantId, r.required_date requiredDate, r.purpose, r.budget_amount budgetAmount, r.status, r.process_instance_id processInstanceId, r.rejection_reason rejectionReason, r.cancellation_reason cancellationReason from pr_requisition r where r.id=#{id} and r.deleted=0

select cast(i.id as char) id, cast(i.material_id as char) materialId, m.code materialCode, m.name materialName, i.quantity, i.estimated_unit_price estimatedUnitPrice, i.remark from pr_requisition_item i join md_material m on m.id=i.material_id where i.requisition_id=#{id} and i.deleted=0
select applicant_id, department_id, budget_amount, status from pr_requisition where id=#{id} and deleted=0 for update
mapper.insert: insert into pr_requisition(requisition_no, department_id, applicant_id, required_date, purpose, budget_amount, created_by, updated_by) values (#{requisitionNo}, #{departmentId}, #{applicantId}, #{requiredDate}, #{purpose}, #{budgetAmount}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: select id from pr_requisition where requisition_no=#{requisitionNo}
mapper.insert: insert into pr_requisition_item(requisition_id, material_id, quantity, estimated_unit_price, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (#{requisitionId}, #{materialId}, #{quantity}, #{estimatedUnitPrice}, #{remark}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.update: update pr_requisition_item set deleted=1, updated_by=#{userId} where requisition_id=#{id} and deleted=0
update pr_requisition set deleted=1, updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from md_material where id=#{materialId} and enabled=1 and deleted=0
